title: WorldOptions
description: Choices offered in New World (B6 R3): world sizes and climates (B2514 FT3: at least temperate and warm). Display texts: ui.new_world.size.<id>, ui.new_world.climate.<id>. All numbers are placeholders until Marcel decides (PR4, F5231).

player_name_max_length.description: Longest player name in the settings (B2535: used only outside the aquarium; inhabitants learn it only when the player tells them).

resources.description: A1770 (B2805 'Einfach'): how much grows and lies on the island - a factor on every spawn rule's density and upper limit (start supplies stay guaranteed). Missing = normal (1.0).

default_resources.description: A1770: id of the preselected resources option.

start_pairs.description: A1770 (B2805): how many pairs of inhabitants a new world starts with (each pair gets its start place).

default_start_pairs.description: A1770: the preselected number of start pairs.

grid_cells.description: A1768 (B2805): width and depth of the island's grid in cells - the generator builds the island in this area (a multiple of the preset's chunk_cells). Placeholder (TL).

factor.description: Factor on spawn density and upper limits (1.0 = the data as written).
